Description: Temporary sidewalk removal and localized excavation adjacent to the existing residence at 444 Via Lido Nord to access the exterior basement/foundation wall for waterproofing following reported saltwater intrusion. The existing horizontal clearance between the foundation stem wall and the adjacent sidewalk is approximately 8 inches, providing insufficient working space for excavation, substrate preparation, and proper installation of the exterior waterproofing system. Temporary removal of a portion of the sidewalk is therefore proposed to establish adequate construction access. Work includes saw-cutting and removing the affected concrete sidewalk, excavating to expose the wall, preparing the substrate, installing waterproofing and a protective layer, backfilling and compacting, and reconstructing the sidewalk to City-approved grades and standards. Temporary barricades, pedestrian access provisions, and excavation support will be provided as required. Work limits, excavation depth, and duration will be shown on the proposed site plan for City review. No permanent encroachment or reduction in sidewalk width is proposed.
